title: Switch it on the half-turn
text: How do you take this pass?
tip: Between the lines, look away from the ball before it comes. The other side is often quiet.

options.text: Turn back the way it came
options.why: That takes you straight into the opponent on the ball side.
It keeps the ball, but the far wing was empty and waiting.

options.text: Open up your body and switch play
options.why: The look showed the ball side was crowded and a mate alone on the far wing. Open up and find them.

scan.prompt: You're between their lines and a pass is coming from the left. Look early.
